questions.solution: Figment का अर्थ है 'मनगढ़ंत बात' (A thing that someone believes to be real but that exists only in their imagination).
A kiosk is a small open-fronted hut or cubicle from which newspapers, refreshments, tickets, etc., are sold. (छोटा दुकान/गुमटी)
A hypothesis is a proposed explanation made on the basis of limited evidence as a starting point for further investigation. / Hypothesis का अर्थ है परिकल्पना या अनुमान।
Evacuated का अर्थ है 'सुरक्षित स्थान पर ले जाना' (Moved to safety).
Garbled means to reproduce a message or sound in a confused and distorted way. / Garbled का अर्थ है अस्पष्ट या भ्रामक रूप से कहना।
A jaunt is a short excursion or journey for pleasure. (मनोरंजन की यात्रा)
Drey is the specific term for a squirrel's nest. (गिलहरी का घोंसला)
Elegy is a poem or song of serious reflection, typically a lament for the dead. (शोकगीत)
Erratum is an error in printing or writing. (छपाई की त्रुटि)
Divisor is the number by which another number is divided. (भाजक)
Gerontocracy is a state, society, or group governed by old people. / Gerontocracy का अर्थ है वृद्ध-तंत्र या बूढ़ों का शासन।
Excursion का अर्थ है 'सैर' या छोटा भ्रमण (A short pleasure trip).
To hamper means to hinder or impede the movement or progress of. / Hamper का अर्थ है बाधा डालना या रोकना।
Extradite का अर्थ है 'प्रत्यर्पण करना' (To hand over a person accused of a crime to the jurisdiction of the foreign state).
A glossary is an alphabetical list of terms with their definitions. / Glossary का अर्थ है शब्द-संग्रह या शब्दावली।
A gourmet is a connoisseur of good food; a person with a discerning palate. / Gourmet का अर्थ है पाक-कला का पारखी या भोजन का विशेषज्ञ।
Fur is the short, fine, soft hair of certain animals. / Fur का अर्थ है जानवरों के कोमल बाल या रोआं।
A herbarium is a collection of dried plants systematically arranged. / Herbarium का अर्थ है वनस्पतियों का संग्रहालय।
Hot-headed means having an impetuous or easily angered temperament. / Hot-headed का अर्थ है उग्र स्वभाव का या जल्दी गुस्सा होने वाला।
Holocaust refers to destruction or slaughter on a mass scale, especially caused by fire. / Holocaust का अर्थ है विध्वंस या भारी विनाश।
A knell is the sound of a bell, especially when rung solemnly for a death or funeral. (शोक सूचक घंटे की ध्वनि)
An invalid is a person made weak or disabled by illness or injury. (बीमार व्यक्ति)
Impartial means treating all rivals or disputants equally; unbiased. / Impartial का अर्थ है निष्पक्ष।
Elucidate means to make something clear or explain it. (स्पष्ट करना या व्याख्या करना)
Double down means to strengthen one's commitment to a policy or strategy. (अपने संकल्प को और मजबूत करना)
Fortuitous means happening by a lucky chance rather than design. / Fortuitous का अर्थ है आकस्मिक या संयोगवश होने वाला लाभ।
Escort is a person, vehicle, ship, or aircraft, accompanying another for protection. (रक्षक या अंगरक्षक)
Fantasy का अर्थ है 'कल्पना' (The faculty or activity of imagining impossible things).
Interregnum is a period when normal government is suspended, especially between successive reigns or regimes. (दो शासनों के बीच का काल)
Disintegrate means to break into small pieces. (टुकड़े-टुकड़े होना या बिखर जाना)
A fundraiser is an event or person whose purpose is to raise money for a cause. / Fundraiser का अर्थ है धन जुटाने वाला व्यक्ति या संस्था।
Ineffable means too great or extreme to be expressed or described in words. (अवर्णनीय - जिसे शब्दों में न कहा जा सके)
Foresight का अर्थ है 'दूरदर्शिता' (The ability to predict what will happen or be needed in the future).
A foyer is a large entrance hall in a public building. / Foyer का अर्थ है प्रवेश-कक्ष या लॉबी।
Elope means to run away secretly in order to get married. (प्रेमी के साथ भाग जाना)
Idiosyncrasy is a mode of behavior or way of thought peculiar to an individual. / Idiosyncrasy का अर्थ है किसी व्यक्ति की विशेष आदत या स्वभाव।
Fauna का अर्थ है 'पशुवर्ग' (The animals of a particular region).
Innocent means not guilty of a particular crime or having no experience of the bad things in life. (निर्दोष - जिसने कोई अपराध न किया हो)
A hypochondriac is a person who is abnormally anxious about their health. / Hypochondriac का अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जिसे अपने स्वास्थ्य की अत्यधिक और अकारण चिंता हो।
Irrevocable means not able to be changed, reversed, or recovered; final. (अटल/अपरिवर्तनीय - जिसे बदला न जा सके)
Idyllic means like an idyll; extremely happy, peaceful, or picturesque. / Idyllic का अर्थ है सुखद, शांत या रमणीय।
A hallucinogen is a drug that causes hallucinations. / Hallucinogen का अर्थ है मतिभ्रम पैदा करने वाली दवा।
Equator is an imaginary line drawn around the earth equally distant from both poles. (भूमध्य रेखा)
Interment is the burial of a corpse in a grave or tomb. (दफन - शव को गाड़ना)
Feud का अर्थ है 'पुश्तैनी झगड़ा' (A prolonged and bitter quarrel or dispute).
Fleet का अर्थ है 'बेड़ा' (A group of ships sailing together).
Heliotherapy is the treatment of disease by means of the rays of the sun. / Heliotherapy का अर्थ है सूर्य-किरण चिकित्सा।
To irrigate is to supply water to land or crops to help growth, typically by means of channels. (सींचना)
Hoot is the deep, hollow cry of an owl. / Hoot का अर्थ है उल्लू की बोली।
Ethnology का अर्थ है 'मानव जाति विज्ञान' (The study of human races).
Exorbitant का अर्थ है 'अत्यधिक' या बहुत ज्यादा (Unreasonably high price).
Epidemic is a widespread occurrence of an infectious disease in a community at a particular time. (महामारी)
Dorsal refers to the back side of an animal or organ. (पृष्ठीय या पीठ का)
Edit means to prepare for publication by correcting, condensing, or otherwise modifying. (संपादन करना)
A hermit is a person living in solitude as a religious discipline. / Hermit का अर्थ है तपस्वी या सन्यासी।
An illustration is a decoration, interpretation or visual explanation of a text, concept or process. / Illustration का अर्थ है चित्रण या उदाहरण देकर समझाना।
Hospitable means being friendly and welcoming to strangers or guests. / Hospitable का अर्थ है सत्कार करने वाला या मिलनसार।
The fuselage is the main body section of an aircraft. / Fuselage का अर्थ है विमान का मुख्य ढांचा।
Egalitarian is a person who advocates or supports the principle of equality for all people. (समानतावादी)
To hibernate means an animal spends the winter in a state like deep sleep. / Hibernate का अर्थ है शीतनिद्रा में होना या सुप्तावस्था में समय बिताना।
Embody means to represent a quality or an idea exactly. (अवतार लेना या साकार करना)
Immobile means not moving; motionless. / Immobile का अर्थ है अचल या स्थिर।
Invulnerable means impossible to harm or damage. (अभेद्य - जिसे नुकसान न पहुँचाया जा सके)
Dwarf is an individual of abnormally small stature. (बौना)
Eternity का अर्थ है 'अनंतकाल' (Time that never ends).
Gingivitis is a common and mild form of gum disease. / Gingivitis का अर्थ है मसूड़ों की सूजन।
Divulge means to make known private or sensitive information. (रहस्य उजागर करना)
Equilibrium is a state in which opposing forces or influences are balanced. (संतुलन)
Evict का अर्थ है 'बेदखल करना' (To force someone to leave a property).
A glazier is a person whose profession is fitting glass into windows and doors. / Glazier का अर्थ है शीशा लगाने वाला व्यक्ति।
Involuntary means done without will or conscious control. (अनैच्छिक - जो इच्छा से न किया गया हो)
Dormitory is a large room containing many beds. (शयनशाला)
Fable का अर्थ है 'नीति-कथा' (A short story, typically with animals as characters, conveying a moral).
Illiterate refers to a person unable to read or write. / Illiterate का अर्थ है अनपढ़ या निरक्षर।
Garrulous means excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters. / Garrulous का अर्थ है बातूनी या बहुत बोलने वाला।
A journey is an act of traveling from one place to another. (यात्रा)
Dominion is the territory of a sovereign or government. (अधिराज्य या शासन क्षेत्र)
Expire का अर्थ है 'समाप्त होना' (To reach the end of a specified period).
A hostess is a woman who receives or entertains guests. / Hostess का अर्थ है सत्कारिणी या मेज़बान महिला।
A janitor is a person employed as a caretaker or doorkeeper of a building. (चौकीदार - इमारत की देखभाल करने वाला)
Incivism means a lack of civic-mindedness or of patriotism. / Incivism का अर्थ है नागरिक बोध या देशभक्ति की कमी।
Heresy is belief or opinion contrary to orthodox religious doctrine. / Heresy का अर्थ है पाखंड या धर्म-विरुद्ध मत।
Flamboyant का अर्थ है 'भड़कीला' (Tending to attract attention because of他们的 exuberance and confidence).
Graphology is the study of handwriting, for example as used to infer a person's character. / Graphology का अर्थ है हस्तलेख विज्ञान।
Edify means to instruct or improve someone morally or intellectually. (नैतिक या आध्यात्मिक उपदेश देना)
Fortnight refers to a period of 14 days or two weeks. / Fortnight का अर्थ है दो सप्ताह या पखवाड़े की अवधि।
Fickle का अर्थ है 'चंचल' (Changing frequently).
Efface means to erase a mark from a surface. (मिटा देना)
A foundling is an infant that has been abandoned by its parents and is discovered and cared for by others. / Foundling का अर्थ है लावारिस बच्चा।
Emigrant is a person who leaves their own country in order to settle permanently in another. (देशत्यागी या प्रवासी)
Exegesis का अर्थ है 'व्याख्या' (Critical interpretation of a text).
An islet is a very small island. (छोटा द्वीप)
Herbivorous refers to an animal that feeds on plants. / Herbivorous का अर्थ है शाकाहारी।
Kin refers to one's family and relations. (रिश्तेदार/परिजन)
Imperialism is a policy of extending a country's power and influence through diplomacy or military force. / Imperialism का अर्थ है साम्राज्यवाद।
Euthanasia का अर्थ है 'इच्छामृत्यु' (Mercy killing).
An honorarium is a payment given for professional services that are rendered nominally without charge. / Honorarium का अर्थ है मानदेय।
To integrate is to combine one thing with another so that they become a whole. (संघटित करना - जोड़कर एक करना)
Horizon is the line at which the earth's surface and the sky appear to meet. / Horizon का अर्थ है क्षितिज।
Fumbling means to use the hands clumsily while doing something. / Fumbling का अर्थ है टटोलना या अनाड़ीपन से काम करना।
Ecstatic means feeling or expressing overwhelming happiness. (अति प्रसन्न)
Ineligible means not having the necessary qualifications to be chosen for something. (अयोग्य - जिसे चुना न जा सके)
Embezzle means to steal money that you are responsible for or that belongs to your employer. (गबन करना)
Follow का अर्थ है 'अनुसरण करना' (To move or travel behind someone or something).
Flaw का अर्थ है 'त्रुटि' या दोष (A mark, blemish, or other imperfection which mars a substance or object).
Endeavour means to try hard to do or achieve something. (प्रयास करना)
Inanimate refers to something not alive, especially not in the manner of animals and humans. / Inanimate का अर्थ है निर्जीव या अचेतन।
Graffiti refers to unauthorized writing or drawing on a public surface. / Graffiti का अर्थ है दीवारों पर की गई चित्रकारी या लिखावट।
Inflorescence is the complete flower head of a plant including stems and stalks. (पुष्पगुच्छ - फूलों का गुच्छा)
Homonyms are words that share the same spelling and pronunciation but have different meanings. / Homonyms का अर्थ है समोच्चारित भिन्नार्थक शब्द।
Innuendo is an allusive or oblique remark or hint, typically a suggestive or disparaging one. (इशारा - गलत भावना से किया गया संकेत)
Inexorable means impossible to stop or prevent, or not persuaded by requests. (हठी/निर्दयी - जिसे प्रार्थना से बदला न जा सके)
An island is a piece of land surrounded by water. (द्वीप)
An isthmus is a narrow strip of land with sea on either side, forming a link between two larger areas of land. (संयोगभूमि - जो दो भूभागों को जोड़ती है)
Embargo is an official ban on trade or other commercial activity with a particular country. (व्यापारिक प्रतिबंध)
Flux का अर्थ है 'प्रवाह' या परिवर्तन (Continuous change).
A glutton is a person who eats or consumes immoderate amounts of food and drink. / Glutton का अर्थ है पेटू या बहुत अधिक खाने वाला।
Erudition is the quality of having or showing great knowledge or learning. (विद्वत्ता)
Insulated means protected by interposing material that prevents the loss of heat or the passage of sound/electricity. (विद्युत-रोधित/ऊष्मारोधी)
Juvenile means relating to young people. (किशोर - जो वयस्क न हो)
Jovial means cheerful and friendly. (उल्लासपूर्ण - प्रसन्नचित्त)
Exit Poll का अर्थ है 'मतदान के बाद का सर्वेक्षण' (Survey after voting).
A 'Hung' assembly occurs when no single political party has enough seats to secure an absolute majority. / 'Hung' (त्रिशंकु) विधानसभा या संसद वह स्थिति है जब किसी भी दल को स्पष्ट बहुमत नहीं मिलता।
To intimidate is to frighten or overawe someone, especially in order to make them do what one wants. (धमकाना)
Engulf means to sweep over something so as to surround or cover it completely. (निगल जाना या घेर लेना)
Effect is a change which is a result or consequence of an action. (प्रभाव या परिणाम)
To hijack means to illegally seize an aircraft, ship, or vehicle while in transit. / Hijack का अर्थ है विमान या वाहन का अपहरण करना।
Genocide is the deliberate killing of a large group of people, especially those of a particular nation or ethnic group. / Genocide का अर्थ है नरसंहार।
Immunity is the state of being resistant to a particular infection or being exempt from a duty or penalty. / Immunity का अर्थ है रोग प्रतिरोधक क्षमता या मुक्ति।
Expurgate का अर्थ है 'आपत्तिजनक अंश निकालना' (To remove matter thought to be objectionable from a book).
Fallow का अर्थ है 'परती जमीन' (Farmland left unsown for a period to restore fertility).
Forge का अर्थ है 'लगातार आगे बढ़ना' (To move forward slowly and steadily).
Effervescent means giving off bubbles; fizzy. (बुदबुदाने वाला या उत्साहपूर्ण)
Dumb refers to a person who is unable to speak. (गूंगा)
Dismal refers to something causing sadness or gloom. (निराशाजनक या उदास)
A hamlet is a small settlement, generally one smaller than a village. / Hamlet का अर्थ है छोटा गाँव या पुरवा।
Equinox is the time or date at which the sun crosses the celestial equator, when day and night are of approximately equal length. (विषुव)
Fratricide is the killing of one's brother or sister. / Fratricide का अर्थ है भाई या बहन की हत्या।
Durable means able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage. (टिकाऊ)
Immune means resistant to a particular infection or toxin. / Immune का अर्थ है प्रतिरक्षित या रोगमुक्त।
A fugitive is a person who has escaped from a place or is in hiding, especially to avoid arrest. / Fugitive का अर्थ है भगोड़ा।
An heir is a person legally entitled to the property or rank of another on that person's death. / Heir का अर्थ है उत्तराधिकारी।
Festal का अर्थ है 'उत्सव संबंधी' (Relating to a festival).
Enshrine means to preserve a right, tradition, or idea in a form that ensures it will be protected and respected. (प्रतिष्ठित करना या सुरक्षित रखना)
Inaccessible means unable to be reached or entered. / Inaccessible का अर्थ है दुर्गम या जहाँ पहुँचा न जा सके।
General is a commander of an army or something affecting the whole. / General का अर्थ है सेनापति या सामान्य/सार्वजनिक।
Exaggerate का अर्थ है 'बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर कहना' (Overstating the facts).
Drizzle means very light rain. (बूंदाबांदी)
Dyke is a barrier used to regulate or hold back water. (तटबंध या बाँध)
Fraud is a person or thing intended to deceive others, typically for financial gain. / Fraud का अर्थ है धोखाधड़ी या जालसाजी।
Fatalism का अर्थ है 'भाग्यवादिता' (The belief that all events are predetermined and therefore inevitable).
Introspection is the examination of one's own conscious thoughts and feelings. (आत्म निरीक्षण)
Journalism is the activity or profession of writing for newspapers, magazines, or news websites. (पत्रकारिता)
Humus is the organic component of soil, formed by the decomposition of organic matter. / Humus का अर्थ है सड़ी पत्तियों की खाद या मिट्टी।
To hoard means to accumulate money or valued objects and hide them away. / Hoard का अर्थ है गुप्त तरीके से जमाखोरी करना।
Extortion का अर्थ है 'जबरन वसूली' (The practice of obtaining something through force).
An imposter is a person who pretends to be someone else in order to deceive others. / Imposter का अर्थ है बहरूपिया या ढोंगी।
Euphemism का अर्थ है 'व्यंगोक्ति' (A mild word used in place of a harsh one).
Idiosyncratic means relating to idiosyncrasy; peculiar or individual. / Idiosyncratic का अर्थ है विशेष या व्यक्तिगत स्वभाव से संबंधित।
A horde is a large group of people, often used in a negative sense. / Horde का अर्थ है लोगों की भारी भीड़ या गिरोह।
A geologist is an expert in the field of geology. / Geologist का अर्थ है भूविज्ञानी।
A hostage is a person seized or held as security for the fulfillment of a condition. / Hostage का अर्थ है बंधक।
Feminist का अर्थ है 'नारीवादी' (A person who supports feminism).
Facsimile का अर्थ है 'अंश' या प्रतिलिपि (An exact copy, especially of written or printed material).
Fidelity का अर्थ है 'वफादारी' (Faithfulness to a person, cause, or belief).
An imbroglio is an extremely confused, complicated, or embarrassing situation. / Imbroglio का अर्थ है उलझन या जटिल परिस्थिति।
A judge is a public officer appointed to decide cases in a court of law. (न्यायाधीश)
Emancipate means to set free, especially from legal, social, or political restrictions. (बंधनमुक्त करना)
Ethics का अर्थ है 'आचार विचार' या नीति शास्त्र (The study of right and wrong).
Fastidious का अर्थ है 'तुनुकमिज़ाज' (Very attentive to and concerned about accuracy and detail).
Falsehood का अर्थ है 'असत्य' या झूठ (The state of being untrue).
Idolatry is the worship of idols. / Idolatry का अर्थ है मूर्ति पूजा।
An itinerary is a planned route or journey. (यात्रा कार्यक्रम)
A journalist is a person who writes for newspapers, magazines, or news websites or prepares news to be broadcast. (पत्रकार)
